settings.title: TesseraScript Configuration
settings.description: Configure which components are available and their default settings.
settings.coreDesc: Manage the core component group and its availability.
settings.reloadNotice: Settings saved. Click 'Apply & Reload' to apply changes.
settings.restoreNotice: Restore all settings to their default values. This action cannot be undone.
settings.chartDesc: Manage the chart component group (ECharts, lazy-loaded) and its availability.
settings.libsDesc: Third-party libraries used by chart components are downloaded on demand. Charts work immediately after install; delete to free space when unused.

card.name: Card
card.desc: General-purpose card component for dashboards and panels

progressbar.name: Progressbar
progressbar.desc: Progress bar component for displaying progress

list.name: List
list.desc: Bullet-point list with accent dots, Lieflat style

tags.name: Tags
tags.desc: Auto-wrapping tag chips with multiple styles

gauge.name: Tick Gauge
gauge.desc: Rounded tick gauge with big center value

rose.name: Petal Rose
rose.desc: Layered rose chart with petals by value

radar.name: Radar
radar.desc: Lieflat polygon radar chart, great for 6-dimension data

tooltips.flags.showHeader: Show title and meta area at the top of the card
tooltips.flags.showHeaderSep: Show separator between header and content
tooltips.flags.showTitle: Display title text in the header
tooltips.flags.showMeta: Display metadata (small label) in the header
tooltips.flags.showValue: Display main value in the header
tooltips.heatmap.showWeekLabels: Show day-of-week labels on the left
tooltips.heatmap.showMonthLabels: Show month labels at the top
tooltips.heatmap.showLegend: Show color legend at the bottom
tooltips.heatmap.locale: Language for month and day names
tooltips.heatmap.fixedDays: Fixed number of days to display (fixed mode)
tooltips.heatmap.cellSize: Size of each cell in pixels
tooltips.progressbar.labelFormat: Label template. {value} = integer percent (50), {raw} = raw ratio (0.5)
tooltips.progressbar.value: Progress value as a ratio, e.g. 0.5 = 50%
tooltips.chart.showLegend: Show legend at the top of the chart
tooltips.chart.smooth: Render the line as a smooth curve
tooltips.chart.area: Fill the area under the line
tooltips.chart.showLabels: Show value labels outside the petals
tooltips.gauge.value: Gauge value as a ratio, e.g. 0.73 = 73%
tooltips.gauge.label: Center label under the big number (empty = remaining ticks)
tooltips.gauge.showTicks: Show tick marks along the gauge arc
tooltips.list.showBullets: Show accent-colored dots before each row
tooltips.list.indent: Left indent of text relative to bullets (CSS value)
tooltips.tags.wrap: Allow tags to wrap onto multiple lines
tooltips.chart.symbolSize: Data point diameter in px (empty = auto 5)
tooltips.chart.lineWidth: Line stroke width in px (empty = auto 2)
tooltips.chart.barMaxWidth: Max bar width in px (empty = auto 28)
tooltips.chart.barRadius: Bar top corner radius in px (empty = auto 6)
tooltips.chart.gridLeft: Distance from axis to the left canvas edge (px)
tooltips.chart.gridRight: Distance from axis to the right canvas edge (px)
tooltips.chart.gridTop: Distance from axis to the top canvas edge (px)
tooltips.chart.gridBottom: Distance from axis to the bottom canvas edge (px)
tooltips.radar.max: Max scale value per dimension; auto-computed when empty
tooltips.radar.showArea: Fill radar polygons with a translucent accent
tooltips.radar.showAxes: Draw axis lines from center to each vertex
